scope: Read-only review of the current wall information-board producer, bounded content input contract, six resource records and local provenance pins

verifiedByThisReview.name: Typed-array packing preserves original bytes
verifiedByThisReview.result: glbForContent add passes typed arrays directly to align, which reads value.buffer with byteOffset and byteLength. The fixed position, normal, UV and index arrays retain their Float32/Uint16 byte representation.

verifiedByThisReview.name: Bounded recipe rejection precedes output publication
verifiedByThisReview.result: Node and Python reject malformed or duplicate IDs, empty/multiline titles, invalid line counts or line shapes, unsupported graphics and invalid hex colors. Python checks glyph coverage and measured title/body overflow before writing any output image because every recipe is first rendered to an in-memory list.

verifiedByThisReview.name: Font, license and tool-version checks are aligned
verifiedByThisReview.result: Python enforces Pillow 12.1.0 and fonttools 4.64.0, fixed font-axis weights and the declared font/OFL SHA values. Local font and OFL bytes match parameters.json. The complete license is in OFL.txt and font-license.txt points to the same official source and license URLs.

verifiedByThisReview.name: Six resource provenance records match the actual current dependencies
verifiedByThisReview.result: All six resource.json files match the actual parameters, generator, contract, helper, requirements, font and OFL file hashes.

verifiedByThisReview.name: Collection and six GLB identities match
verifiedByThisReview.method: Local file SHA-256 and byte-length comparison
verifiedByThisReview.result: The six collection entries refer to the same IDs and asset SHA values as their resource.json files. Every registered GLB SHA and byte length matches its current local file.

verifiedByThisReview.name: Content remains separate from board and instance identity
verifiedByThisReview.result: Four wall frame resources keep mountRole information-board and an empty state. Two independent content resources keep mount information-surface, information-face-v1, 1100x700 pixels and the visible boolean semantics. Content source and PNG hashes belong to content resources, not frame-specific baked text.

limits: This review did not run browser or GPU checks and does not independently establish visual or fixed-build acceptance.
The root reported dev c69677ce9625 browser 8/8 and source-input 9/9 passes. Those are root-owned results and were not repeated by this reviewer.
Official font URL bytes were verified and corrected by root. This reviewer verified the local corrected font/OFL hashes and provenance consistency, without repeating the network download.

This is a bounded review of the current validated source and six generated outputs, not a claim of arbitrary text/image-layout support or an atomic filesystem transaction for all possible write failures.
